sentences.en: Could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station?
sentences.ru: Не подскажете, как добраться до ближайшей станции метро?

sentences.en: I usually wake up at seven, but on weekends I sleep until nine.
sentences.ru: Обычно я просыпаюсь в семь, но по выходным сплю до девяти.

sentences.en: She has been learning English for two years, and her pronunciation is getting better.
sentences.ru: Она учит английский два года, и её произношение улучшается.

sentences.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home and watch a movie.
sentences.ru: Если завтра будет дождь, мы останемся дома и посмотрим фильм.

sentences.en: We missed the last bus, so we had to walk home.
sentences.ru: Мы опоздали на последний автобус, поэтому пришлось идти домой пешком.

sentences.en: He forgot his keys at work and had to call a locksmith.

sentences.en: The meeting has been moved from Monday to Wednesday.

sentences.en: I'm thinking about changing jobs, but I haven't decided yet.
sentences.ru: Я думаю о смене работы, но ещё не решил.

sentences.en: They moved to a smaller apartment to save money on rent.

sentences.en: Would you mind closing the window? It's getting cold in here.

sentences.en: She apologised for being late and explained that the train was delayed.

sentences.en: After dinner, we usually go for a short walk around the block.

sentences.en: He promised to call me back as soon as the meeting ended.

sentences.en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny all week.

sentences.en: You can pay by card or in cash, whichever you prefer.
sentences.ru: Вы можете заплатить картой или наличными, как вам удобнее.

sentences.ru: Аккумулятор телефона сел прямо посреди нашего разговора.

sentences.en: We decided to postpone the trip until the weather improves.
sentences.ru: Мы решили отложить поездку, пока погода не улучшится.

sentences.en: Honestly, I didn't expect the movie to be that good.

sentences.en: If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask.

sentences.en: It's important to stay calm when something goes wrong.

sentences.en: The library is quiet, which makes it a great place to study.

sentences.en: My flight lands at noon, so I'll take a taxi to the hotel.

sentences.en: Let's meet in front of the cinema at half past six.

sentences.en: It's much cheaper to cook at home than to eat out.

sentences.en: They apologised for the noise and promised to be quieter.

sentences.en: I'll call you back in five minutes, because I'm driving right now.

sentences.en: My neighbour plays the guitar every evening, and I don't mind at all.

sentences.en: I would rather stay in tonight because I have an early start tomorrow.

sentences.en: Please let me know if you need anything else.

sentences.en: It took me almost an hour to find a parking spot downtown.

sentences.ru: Поезд до аэропорта отходит каждые пятнадцать минут.

sentences.ru: Оказывается, магазин по воскресеньям закрыт.
